questions.question: What did Elihu say God does to the afflicted?
options: Opens their ears through adversity to instruct them
Ignores them entirely and turns away his face
Destroys them suddenly without any kind of prior warning
Forgets all about them in their hour of need
questions.answer: Opens their ears through adversity to instruct them

questions.question: How did Elihu describe God?
options: Weak and unable to save the just
Mighty, and great in power and understanding
Distant and removed from human affairs
Unjust toward the innocent and upright
questions.answer: Mighty, and great in power and understanding
